## Sep 20 Performance: The Model Crushed It

Let me hit you with the numbers from yesterday's slate. We went 11-4 across 10 games for a 73.3% accuracy rate. That's not luck—that's what happens when you trust the data. Our confidence levels ranged from 50% to 62%, and even our lowest-confidence picks hit at a respectable rate.

## Breaking Down The Results

Our picks above 60% confidence went 8-1. That's an 88.9% hit rate when the model showed strong conviction. The only miss in that range was the Rangers pick at 60% confidence. Meanwhile, our 50% confidence plays split 1-1, which is exactly what you'd expect from coin-flip scenarios.

## Key Takeaway: Trust The 60+ Range

Look at this stat: when our model showed 60%+ confidence, we hit 88.9% of the time. That's the sweet spot where the data converges and the edge becomes undeniable. The Pirates (62%), Cubs (61%), Guardians (61%), and Mariners (61%) all cashed as expected.

## Sep 21 Preview: Blue Jays at Orioles

Tomorrow's top pick brings us a 54% confidence level on the Toronto Blue Jays visiting Baltimore. The pitching matchup features Trey Yesavage taking the ball for Toronto against Shane Baz for the Orioles. It's not our highest conviction play, but the numbers show a slight edge for the visitors.
